project.name: Insta3D / MaklerTour
project.goal: Capture real-estate spaces and transform authenticated session media into browsable, globally consistent metric 3D deliverables while retaining panorama-tour workflows.
project.evidencePolicy: Runtime and executable code outrank current-status documents, task plans and legacy roadmap checkboxes.

workItems.title: Order, session and 360 tour MVP
workItems.objective: Manage assignments, capture sessions, media and private/public tours.
workItems.description: Established business and viewing foundation for capture workflows.
evidence: ROADMAP P0/P1 marks the core flow complete
Order/tour APIs, templates and viewers exist

workItems.title: Durable Android capture and upload foundation
workItems.objective: Capture media, persist local state and upload it against order/session identity.
workItems.description: Insta360 and phone capture, Room repositories, queue and mobile API foundation used by later modes.
evidence: Executable camera providers, Room entities/DAOs and queue orchestration
Phone scan MVP records an end-to-end smoke workflow

workItems.title: Automatic photo capture to Photo SfM/viewer
workItems.objective: Turn automatic JPEG sessions into safe sparse/dense preview artifacts.
workItems.description: Android capture exists and backend B01-B06 implementations/results exist, while the parent epic remains in progress and runtime coverage is not uniformly closed.
evidence: AUTO Photo epic confirms Android bundle path
B01-B06 result documents and tests

workItems.title: Server storage and GrafikStation job orchestration
workItems.objective: Own storage/job state, launch remote processing and publish validated artifacts.
workItems.description: PHP state machine coordinates SSH-controlled station runners for extract, sparse, dense, mesh, export and stereo jobs.
evidence: Worker dispatches concrete job types and validates results
Station status/fetch/cleanup scripts exist

workItems.title: SINGLE reference sparse/dense reconstruction
workItems.objective: Produce reproducible visual reconstruction from standalone phone video.
workItems.description: Frame extraction, sequential COLMAP sparse, dense/mesh/export and recorded audits establish a working baseline, not final geometry quality.
evidence: SFM-S01 stage PASS records
Reference job and controlled A/B artifacts are documented

workItems.title: SINGLE visual connectivity and drift experiments
workItems.objective: Test bounded non-local visual edges without promoting exhaustive matching.
workItems.description: Exhaustive and Hybrid v1 improved connectivity, but physical closure and stable geometry are unproven; Hybrid v2 is not run.
evidence: A/B audit reports 6 to 1 components with mixed geometry metrics
Hybrid v2 audit says NOT_RUN

workItems.title: Synchronized IMU/ToF evidence and metric diagnostics
workItems.objective: Capture, align and validate physical observations without mutating RGB geometry.
workItems.description: ToF firmware-to-registered-anchor stages are closed and SINGLE diagnostics measure scale/residuals; IMU affects selection and diagnostics.
evidence: LM03.1 through LM03.5C marked CLOSED
S01H measurement results and static participation audits

workItems.title: Active IMU pose prior and ToF metric constraints
workItems.objective: Use physical priors to reduce drift and establish metric geometry.
workItems.description: Current sensor path is explicitly measurement/diagnostic only; controlled optimizer experiments are required.
evidence: IMU audit: not active constraint
ToF audit: geometry mutation and fusion OFF

workItems.title: Unify SINGLE, dual-phone, USB rig and laptop contracts
workItems.objective: Give all topologies explicit identities, profiles, timelines and server-compatible packages.
workItems.description: Five real capture paths currently differ in recorders, clocks, sidecars and consumers.
evidence: Recovery plan declares SINGLE-first unification
Android architecture audit maps five divergent paths

workItems.title: Dual-phone synchronized recorded capture
workItems.objective: Capture two calibrated role packages with shared identity and accepted server upload.
workItems.description: Control, clock and recording foundation has runtime evidence; telemetry acceptance and PHP contract closure remain.
evidence: Real two-phone control cycle recorded
Android capture type is absent from PHP allowlist

workItems.title: Phone plus USB calibrated synced capture
workItems.objective: Produce valid calibrated stereo pairs/bundles with operator preflight.
workItems.description: Native UVC and synced capture paths exist; F02 Android build/device acceptance remains pending and ToF is not persisted.
evidence: F02-A/B implemented status
Current native UVC/stereo capture source

workItems.title: Metric stereo trajectory and initial global cloud
workItems.objective: Convert pair-local metric depth into globally aligned geometry.
workItems.description: F01A pair clouds, F01B ORB odometry and F01C direct fusion are wired, but runtime acceptance and final optimization are missing.
evidence: F01 task headers say implemented/wired and runtime pending
Current fused result contract declares incomplete/no ICP

workItems.title: Multi-component review, alignment and assembly
workItems.objective: Review, bridge, align, merge and publish disconnected reconstruction components.
workItems.description: Workbench/manual alignment and lineage features exist with tests, while post-workbench bridging remains active.
evidence: Workbench and manual-align task/test families
Post-workbench roadmap identifies next bridge work

workItems.title: Globally consistent metric mesh with textures
workItems.description: Requires accepted global metric geometry, mesh generation and original-frame texture projection.
evidence: Stereo current status declares this the primary target
Roadmap P4 lists mesh/texture/viewer stages

workItems.title: Dollhouse, floorplan and photorealistic viewer
workItems.objective: Deliver navigable spatial and photorealistic presentation modes.
workItems.description: Long-term viewer/measurement/segmentation and optional splat or NeRF work.
evidence: Roadmap P4 and P6 only

dependencies.rationale: Capture sessions and uploads require order/session ownership and visibility.
Auto Photo reuses the packager, queue and capture-bundle endpoint.
The worker launches and publishes SINGLE extract/COLMAP jobs.
Controlled experiments reuse the reference frames, intrinsics and mapper.
Sensor diagnostics compare observations against completed geometry.
The current decision sequence permits one bounded visual run before escalating to physical priors.
Active constraints require validated clocks, calibration and observation identity.
The recovery plan declares stabilized SINGLE as reference, although contract work may overlap.
Dual capture reuses phone recorder, sidecars, packaging and queue.
Producer and server consumer need one shared identity/package contract.
The recovery plan requires common descriptors, profiles and normalized timestamps.
The synced dense job requires calibrated paired frames and extrinsics.
Dual role packages require accepted server materialization before stereo processing.
The SINGLE branch needs accepted metric geometry before mesh productization.
Metric pair clouds and trajectory are direct global geometry inputs.
The video-SfM route needs component placement before one publishable mesh.
Dollhouse and metric viewer features depend on accepted spatial assets.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Captured files are non-empty, durably bound to stable session identity and uploaded only after order/session authorization; terminal status reflects actual completion.
Safe indexing/materialization, prepared frames, sparse review/export, simple view and bounded dense preview complete without trusting archive paths.
A job succeeds only with valid result JSON, expected source/job identity and non-empty required artifacts.
A phone video reaches frame extraction, COLMAP sparse and inspectable export/dense artifacts.
On immutable inputs, a bounded pair graph reduces fragmentation and expands temporal coverage without unacceptable reprojection or trajectory-step regressions; all diagnostics are preserved.
Timing and calibration identity gates pass while geometry mutation/fusion remain off and RGB fallback remains non-blocking.
A controlled visual-only versus physical-prior A/B improves drift or metric error, reports residuals and preserves fallback for missing/poor sensor data.
Each mode has one versioned descriptor for identity, roles, profiles, clock, calibration and optional sidecars, accepted consistently by Android and PHP.
Both phones complete the recorded lifecycle and the server accepts/materializes both role packages with shared identity and actual timestamp provenance.
Invalid pairs/calibration are rejected before packaging; a valid capture yields operator-visible success and an accepted calibrated bundle.
A real calibrated capture produces validated pair clouds, trajectory and global PLY; completion is not claimed until optimization/closure acceptance passes.
An independent room capture yields reproducible globally consistent metric geometry, a triangle mesh and textures with artifact provenance and viewer loading.
